The whole of Ironjaw Sound at war, built: The whole of Ironjaw Sound at war, built like the stock Escalation, with two fronts. In the west, armour fights over the Cinder Range: Boscali roll north from the Delta Gate depot, Primeva south from Cinder Gate, and helicopters from the Dunmore West and Dunmore East FARPs fight over Dunmore Crossing. In the centre, jets meet over Halvard Arm: Boscali fly from Fenwick Field and a carrier off the Ostrin Isles, Primeva from Graylock South. Each side has aircraft factories and an enrichment plant at home and vehicle factories feeding its forward depot. Factories build new airframes all match, so the heavy jets arrive late. Reinforcements come down the Cinder Notch road and the west road through Hollin Mine. The Ostrin Isles, Dunmore Crossing and Hollin Mine start neutral and become forward spawns for whoever takes them; Primeva can lose Skerry and Graylock South, Boscali can lose Fenwick once the Delta Gate depot breaks. Every capture puts more aircraft in the air, and a broken depot more again. Break the enemy forward depot, then destroy their aircraft factories to win. Everyone starts at rank 0; nuclear weapons clear at escalation 256.

The whole of Ironjaw Sound at war, built like the stock Escalation. Boscali hold the south: Sorrel Field, Rook Island, Kittiwake FARP and the Delta Gate FARP. Primeva hold the fjords and the north-east: Tarn Head Strip, Graylock Strip, Graylock South, Brekka Hills and the Cinder Gate FARP. Boscali have two aircraft factory complexes and an enrichment plant by Sorrel Field; Primeva build their aircraft far away in the north-east, on the Graylock plain and in the Brekka Hills, with the enrichment plant at the head of Graylock Fjord, and vehicle factories feeding a depot at its forward FARP. Factories build new airframes over the whole match, so the heavy jets arrive late. Armour rolls from the start and reinforcement columns come down the Cinder Notch road and the west road through Hollin Mine. Five landing zones in between start neutral and become forward spawns for whoever takes them. Break the enemy forward depot, then destroy their aircraft factories to win. Everyone starts at rank 0; nuclear weapons clear at escalation 256.
A Confrontation-style war: A Confrontation-style war over the east half of the map. Boscali fly from a carrier group south of Kittiwake and from the Fenwick and Kittiwake landing zones; Primeva fly from Graylock Strip, Graylock South and Brekka Hills. Aircraft factories west of Fenwick and on the Graylock peninsula build new airframes. The Ostrin Isles and Skerry Island start neutral; helicopter troops take them. Destroy the enemy aircraft factories to win. Everyone starts at rank 0.
A Primeva amphibious fleet is massing: A Primeva amphibious fleet is massing east of Ansel Reach to seize Port Ansel, with a second wave coming up Gannet Sound later. Boscali must sink the fleets before they burn the port's fuel tanks; Primeva win if the tank farm burns. AI aircraft fly for both sides.
A small, Altercation-size strike: A small, Altercation-size strike up Graylock Fjord. A Boscali carrier group waits well south of the fjord mouth with a forward pad on Skerry Island. Primeva hold the fjord with corvettes, SAM sites, a long-range battery and armour guarding the supply depot at the Sill, the narrow crossing at the fjord head. Boscali must destroy the depot and its guard; Primeva win if they hold out for 45 minutes or sink the carrier.
Primeva has walled off the Lower Ice: Primeva has walled off the Lower Ice. Three layers stand between Fenwick and the Col Works enrichment plant. First, a radar picket at the Gate on the inner bay's north shore, 11 km out, watches everything that leaves Fenwick. Kill it and their fighters go half-blind. Next, a depot and armour park on the glacier. A radar SAM, SAM-A1, sits on the open ice 5 km beyond it and switches on the moment the Gate falls. The ridges hide it from Fenwick, but it sees straight down the ice, so come over the ridges, not up the glacier. Last, the Col Works, under a second radar SAM on the ridge north of the plant. You'll be cleared for tactical weapons by then. Knock out either of its two enrichment plants and the reactor never starts. Every known SAM is on your map. Expect their fighters within two minutes, and strikes on Fenwick's fuel farm 2 km past the north-east end of the strip, coming from the north-east. Guns and MANPADS ring the runway and the climb-out, but they cannot reach the farm: the farm is yours and two escort pairs to defend. Lose the farm, or let the 60-minute clock run out, and we lose.
Primeva have spread seven long-range SAM: Primeva have spread seven long-range SAM sites across the fjord country, with a mobile SAM patrolling the Cinder Notch road. Boscali must destroy every SAM radar within an hour; Primeva win if the umbrella survives. AI aircraft fly for both sides.
Take part in a PALA operation: Take part in a PALA operation to bait and encircle BDF ground forces before systematically annihilating them in an outdated airframe being pushed to its limits.

NEEDS: NOCustomMaps 1.4+:
NEEDS: NOCustomMaps 1.4+ and the Cascadia map, build cm.cascadia.2546c698 (install "Cascadia Falling" with the Nuclear Option Mod Manager, or put cascadia-0.1.0.nomapz in BepInEx\plugins\NOCustomMaps\maps). Everyone in a session needs that same map build. Optional: NOGridLetters for readable grid callouts.

Cascadia Falling. PALA attacks Puget Sound from the Pacific and the Strait of Georgia; BDF defends from Tacoma. PvP: both sides can be joined.

BDF starts with nearly everything: 9 airfields, 4 FOBs, 7 pads, 4 nuclear silo fields, two Hyperion carriers at three naval bases and picket pairs across the Sound. PALA holds CFB Comox and has two carrier groups at sea from T+0, each 1 Hyperion, 2 Argus, 2 Dynamo, 4 corvettes and an Annex: one entering the Strait of Juan de Fuca from the Pacific (grid P8) steaming east, one at the top of the Strait of Georgia (grid E12) steaming south through Rosario Strait. They meet off Port Townsend, then push through Admiralty Inlet and down the Sound in line astern, the western force to Commencement Bay off Tacoma and the northern to Elliott Bay off Seattle. A new group enters on each axis every ten minutes from T+20 to T+120, each a little further out than the one before, and follows the same track, carrier groups again at T+30 and T+70 and four-ship surface groups between, and the carriers launch AI aircraft all mission. Then come high-altitude Alkyon anti-ship strikes and Darkreach packages, landing craft at Port Angeles and Birch Bay, I-5 and mountain columns, Tarantula lifts dropping 6x6 AA onto the pads with Brawler and Revoker cover, and from T+95 nuclear strike packages on the silo fields. Everything PALA captures builds for PALA.

BDF wins by sinking all 6 assault carriers (the last arrives at T+70) or holding JBLM, Fort Lewis FOB, the Port of Tacoma and the Narrows until T+150. PALA wins by taking those four; every other BDF airfield, FOB, pad and naval base is a PALA objective on the way, and each silo field is one to put out of action. Strategic release comes at T+90 and arms the 24 silo launchers.

Map key cm.cascadia.2546c698. Map and plugin: github.com/netmaster296/CascadiaFalling.
